title: I am doing (present continuous)
summary: Present continuous (**am/is/are + -ing**) — действие, которое происходит **прямо сейчас**, в момент речи.
ru:
## Когда используем
Present continuous говорит о том, что **происходит сейчас** (в момент речи или вокруг него). В русском это обычное настоящее время: «Я работаю», «Идёт дождь».
> Please be quiet. I'**m working**. — Тише, пожалуйста. Я работаю (сейчас).
> Look! It'**s raining**. — Смотри! Идёт дождь.
> The children **are playing** in the park. — Дети играют в парке.

## Как образуется
**am / is / are + глагол с -ing**
> I **am** read**ing**. He **is** work**ing**. They **are** watch**ing** TV.
Отрицание: добавляем **not** после be.
> She **isn't** eating. — Она не ест (сейчас).
> I'**m not** watching TV. — Я не смотрю телевизор.

## Правила написания -ing
- Обычно просто **+ ing**: work → working, play → playing.
- Глагол на **-e**: убираем e → **come → coming, write → writing, dance → dancing**.
- Одна гласная + одна согласная: **удваиваем** согласную → **run → running, sit → sitting, swim → swimming**.
- **lie → lying**.

## Слова-подсказки
**now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen!**
> Where is Tom? — He's having a shower **at the moment**.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I working now.~~ → I **am** working now. (be обязателен)
- ~~She is work now.~~ → She is **working** now.
- ~~He is comeing.~~ → He is **coming**.
- ~~They are runing.~~ → They are **running**.
- ~~I am wanting a coffee.~~ → I **want** a coffee. (want, like, know в continuous не используем — см. unit 8)
en:
## When do we use it?
We use the present continuous for something that is **happening now**, at the moment of speaking.
> Please be quiet. I'**m working**.
> Look! It'**s raining**.
> The children **are playing** in the park.

## How to make it
**am / is / are + verb + -ing**
> I **am** read**ing**. He **is** work**ing**. They **are** watch**ing** TV.
Negative: put **not** after be.
> She **isn't** eating.
> I'**m not** watching TV.

## Spelling of -ing
- Most verbs: **+ ing** (work → working).
- Verbs ending in **-e**: drop the e (**come → coming, write → writing**).
- One vowel + one consonant: double the consonant (**run → running, sit → sitting, swim → swimming**).
- **lie → lying**.

## Time words
**now, at the moment, today, Look!, Listen!**

## Common mistakes
- ~~I working now.~~ → I **am** working now.
- ~~He is comeing.~~ → He is **coming**.
- ~~They are runing.~~ → They are **running**.
structure:
## Утверждение и отрицание
| Подлежащее | be | + -ing | Краткие формы |
|---|---|---|---|
| I | am (not) | working | I'm working / I'm not working |
| he / she / it | is (not) | working | he's working / he isn't working |
| we / you / they | are (not) | working | they're working / they aren't working |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + **am / is / are (not)** + глагол**-ing**
> Tom **is cooking** dinner. · We **aren't watching** TV.

## Правила написания
| Правило | Пример |
|---|---|
| + ing | work → working, play → playing |
| -e → убираем e | come → coming, write → writing, make → making |
| удвоение согласной | run → running, sit → sitting, swim → swimming, stop → stopping |
| -ie → -ying | lie → lying |

## Сигнальные слова
- **now, at the moment, today, these days**
- **Look!**, **Listen!**

## Две формы отрицания
- She **isn't** eating. = She**'s not** eating.
- They **aren't** working. = They**'re not** working.

exercises.title: Что они делают?
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в форму present continuous (утверждение).
exercises.example: She (eat) an apple. → She **is eating** an apple.

items.text: He {{is waiting|'s waiting}} for a bus.
I {{am sitting|'m sitting}} on the floor.
She {{is swimming|'s swimming}} in the river.
The cat {{is lying|'s lying}} on the table.

exercises.title: Утверждение или отрицание
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в present continuous: утвердительно или отрицательно — по смыслу.

items.text: Please be quiet. I {{am working|'m working}}.
It's sunny now. It {{isn't raining|is not raining|'s not raining}}.
Tom is in the kitchen. He {{is cooking|'s cooking}} dinner.
You can turn off the TV. I {{am not watching|'m not watching}} it.
Listen! Somebody {{is singing|'s singing}} in the street.
The children {{aren't sleeping|are not sleeping|'re not sleeping}}. They're in the garden.

items.q: I ___ my homework at the moment.

exercises.title: Напишите предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение в present continuous из слов.

answers: They are building a new house.
I am not watching TV now.
Tom is standing on my foot.
We aren't going to the party.
We're not going to the party.
We are not going to the party.
We are waiting for a bus.
We are waiting for the bus.
You are sitting on my chair.

exercises.title: Что вы делаете сейчас?
exercises.instruction: Напишите о себе, о том, что происходит сейчас. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: Где вы сейчас находитесь и что вы носите?
items.sample: I'm at home. I'm wearing a T-shirt.

items.prompt: Что делает ваша мама / ваш друг прямо сейчас?

items.sample: It's raining. The sun isn't shining.
